checks.detail: Docker is bounded to 2 CPUs, 8 GiB memory and 8 GiB memory+swap, no network, and each command has a finite timeout
Before every subprocess, requires 8 GiB available, PSI full avg10 < 1, combined host memory+swap below 85%
During execution, stops on low available memory, high combined use, repeated high PSI, or cap+15 host watchdog; external timeout kill-after is 5 s
Verilator commands use --assert/-Wall and no -Wno-fatal; C++ flags include -Wall -Wextra -Werror; compile output rejects %Warning-
PASS assigned only after all seeded scalar/generic/caller checks complete; command nonzero is failure
UTC microsecond attempt/build names and exclusive mkdir; collisions fail instead of overwriting
Command and resource snapshot are persisted before each subprocess; attempt receipt receives later error/final artifact state
Review note: actual_RTL_run is set before Popen; a Docker process-creation failure could leave it true though no simulator started
Current fixture/scalar/successor verifier blockers are documented as pending prerequisites, not treated as runtime-policy defects

actual_RTL_run is persisted true before subprocess.Popen for simulation commands; if Docker fails to spawn, the receipt may overstate simulator invocation. Consider setting the flag at the invocation boundary while preserving pre-launch receipt durability.

The attempt receipt is first persisted by command() after snapshot/setup staging; a staging failure can leave an empty attempt directory without receipt. This is also the established V125 runner pattern.
